evidence_spans: For the trilayer 1T ′-WS2 case, increasing the interlayer spacing opens a band gap and induces a QSHI phase reported for ∆d >0.18 ˚A (Fig. 6(c)).
induces a QSHI phase reported for ∆d >0.18 ˚A
We evaluate the indirect band gap and topological characterization at statically varied interlayer spacings using HSE hybrid-functional calculations for an accurate description.
CLM-MAT-0084.statement: Static HSE calculations indicate that trilayer 1T′-WS2 transitions to a QSHI phase for interlayer spacing expansion Δd greater than 0.18 Å.

extra_quotes: We relaxed the ground-state structures of monolayer, bilayer, and trilayer 1T ′-WX2 (X= S or Se) using density functional theory as implemented in Quantum ESPRESSO 46.
For the electronic-structure and topology analysis, we used the HSE06 hybrid functional 50 for monolayer, bilayer, and trilayer 1T ′-WX2.
We performed Ehrenfest dynamics using a homemade rt-TDDFT code based on Quantum ESPRESSO and tested it with Octopus 41,53.

Although our rt-TDDFT simulation does not provide enough interlayer spacing to compare with our static analysis of the topological phase transition, our first-principles calculation result may under- or overestimate the critical distance due to DFT inaccuracies in the band gap.
